queue_policy.protected_test_access: prohibited unless separately authorized and registered

ideas.title: Source-aware belief sensor model
ideas.capability_objective: Estimate a calibrated belief over the current latent state from source-authorized sensor evidence, then forecast coherent future outcomes while representing uncertainty in stale or missing observations.
ideas.source: UCI501 licensed sensor source; source SHA-256 d1b9261c54132f04c374f762f1e5e512af19f95c95fd6bfa1e8ac7e927e3b0b8; FIT 2013-2014, exposed DEV 2015, protected TEST 2016-2017 closed.
scope_and_unknowns: The ME101 preregistration is forthcoming; its actual fit, source, mathematics, and runtime gates remain independent of this queue declaration.
2015 DEV outcomes were previously exposed; use only under the registered bounded screening role, and keep 2016-2017 TEST closed.
The belief representation and calibrated uncertainty must be specified against the complete source-to-output graph.
No claim of source authority, late-arrival handling, action utility, independent intelligence, or superiority follows from this objective alone.

ideas.title: Geometry-constrained, entity-selective parallel world-state intelligence
ideas.capability_objective: Improve authenticated delayed-state retrieval and future-state prediction through source-authorized entity-selective memory while preserving the exact associative input-only scan, bounded primary dynamic state, and reliable streaming.
ideas.source: NEXT-SHARED-SELECTIVE direction dated 2026-10-25; prior art pointers include DeepSeek-V3, mHC, Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup, and Native Sparse Attention. A qualified new longitudinal source is still required.
scope_and_unknowns: Entity authority, natural delay/occlusion, map provenance, and useful old-information headroom require source audit.
Admission, geometry, static lookup, and CED are integrated candidate mechanisms, not established gains; attribution studies are later and conditional.
All six existing model families share one candidate core; this is not a seventh family.
No ALOHA exposed DEV retuning or protected TEST access is allowed.

ideas.title: Channel-selective representations
ideas.capability_objective: Preserve and retrieve the sensor or feature channels that carry predictive value at the target horizon, with explicit missingness and source validity.
ideas.source: Candidate extension to source-qualified longitudinal real sensor records; channel utility and missingness must be observed in that source.
scope_and_unknowns: Must remain integrated with the shared core and source-aware belief objective.
Predictive channel selection, calibration effects, and compute benefit are unmeasured.
Do not claim a feature-importance or causal explanation from attention or learned gates alone.

ideas.title: Coherent multi-horizon sensor forecasting
ideas.capability_objective: Forecast multiple future horizons from one consistent predictive distribution, preserving cross-horizon coherence and useful calibrated uncertainty.
ideas.source: Authentic sensor sequences with actual future measurements across registered horizons; prior ME098/ME099 trajectory evidence is mixed and its full gate failed.
scope_and_unknowns: The known ME098/ME099 evidence remains immutable; four-of-five ME099 full-gate passes do not qualify the study.
Future horizon definitions, source sampling clocks, and calibration targets require prospective specification.
No additional fit is implied by this queue entry.

ideas.title: Entity/event multimodal typed heads
ideas.capability_objective: Represent source-identified entities and typed events across available modalities, then predict observed state transitions without leaking future identity or event information.
ideas.source: Qualified longitudinal event records with source-authorized identity, timestamps, typed event definitions, and aligned observed outcomes across modalities.
scope_and_unknowns: Modality availability, event ontology, entity continuity, and source authority have not been established.
All additional encoders and heads count toward the 95k-105k trained and deployed model budget.
Forecasting observed events does not identify causal action effects or workflow completion.

ideas.title: CED refinement only when useful
ideas.capability_objective: Determine whether bounded Concept Exchange Decoder refinement improves a preregistered real capability objective enough to justify its parameters, inference depth, and state costs.
ideas.source: Original PR331 CED design (untrained) and a future qualified real cohort with measurable outcomes; no real capability gain currently established.
scope_and_unknowns: PR331 remains an untrained historical design; its name and proposed refinement depth are not evidence of useful reasoning.
CED is conditional on a capability question and source cohort, not an automatic architecture requirement.
Any later attribution comparison requires preregistered, trained, parameter-matched arms and complete budget parity.
